verdicts.reason: Quote states a hard performance target for flag latency (S edges, up to S+2 with metastability model) measured by simulation; scenario check is appropriate. Latency is a multi-cycle measurement, so not a per-cycle assertion.
This is a process/sign-off guideline about how to claim timing closure, not a design behaviour that can be verified or exercised in simulation (check=none).

questions.question: What is S (number of synchronizer stages) and which configuration (combinational flags vs metastability model) applies to the S vs S+2 target? Is the latency target exact or a maximum, and is it measured for both full and empty flags, in which direction (write-to-empty deassertion, read-to-full deassertion)?
